system.description:
Secret (a seed). Study: 4 weeks, DC 15, a Wisdom check (a Druid in half the time).

  • Plant it beside a tree, or feed it to a beast Awaken could affect: it is awakened as the spell says, but the charm never ends and it stays your loyal friend.
  • The seed is used up.
  • One seed a century falls from a Nalwood that has walked.
  • The druids of Treaty Hold would kill to keep it from the wrong hands.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
